# alvo:    EnsureConnMark
# cenário: onprem_2wan
# sobre:   a máquina de produção do dono: duas WANs (uma PPPoE, uma ethernet) mais uma
#          LAN em 192.168.3.0/24. É esta saída que não pode mudar.
# entrada: wans = [{"ppp0" 0x64} {"enp2s0" 0xc8}]
# formato: `argv` é o CONTRATO (um token por argumento, entre aspas);
#          `cmd ` é o mesmo comando como se lê no shell.
#          exec = Execute, read = ExecuteRead (o `nft list table` do Persist
#          aparece aqui: é a prova de que o Persist rodou).
# retorno: nil
#
# GERADO POR zonas_golden_test.go. Um diff aqui é uma mudança no que o
# firewall manda ao kernel — nunca edite este arquivo para fazer um teste passar.

 1. exec  argv  "nft" "add" "chain" "inet" "linkguard" "conn_mark" "{ type filter hook prerouting priority mangle + 10; policy accept; }"
          cmd   nft add chain inet linkguard conn_mark { type filter hook prerouting priority mangle + 10; policy accept; }
 2. exec  argv  "nft" "add" "chain" "inet" "linkguard" "output_mark" "{ type route hook output priority mangle; policy accept; }"
          cmd   nft add chain inet linkguard output_mark { type route hook output priority mangle; policy accept; }
 3. exec  argv  "nft" "add" "chain" "inet" "linkguard" "conn_mark_out" "{ type filter hook forward priority mangle; policy accept; }"
          cmd   nft add chain inet linkguard conn_mark_out { type filter hook forward priority mangle; policy accept; }
 4. exec  argv  "nft" "flush" "chain" "inet" "linkguard" "conn_mark"
          cmd   nft flush chain inet linkguard conn_mark
 5. exec  argv  "nft" "add" "rule" "inet" "linkguard" "conn_mark" "iifname" "\"enp2s0\"" "ct" "state" "new" "counter" "ct" "mark" "set" "0xc8"
          cmd   nft add rule inet linkguard conn_mark iifname "enp2s0" ct state new counter ct mark set 0xc8
 6. exec  argv  "nft" "add" "rule" "inet" "linkguard" "conn_mark" "iifname" "\"ppp0\"" "ct" "state" "new" "counter" "ct" "mark" "set" "0x64"
          cmd   nft add rule inet linkguard conn_mark iifname "ppp0" ct state new counter ct mark set 0x64
 7. exec  argv  "nft" "add" "rule" "inet" "linkguard" "conn_mark" "iifname" "!=" "{ \"enp2s0\", \"ppp0\" }" "ct" "mark" "!=" "0x0" "ct" "mark" "and" "0x10000" "==" "0x0" "ct" "direction" "reply" "counter" "meta" "mark" "set" "ct" "mark"
          cmd   nft add rule inet linkguard conn_mark iifname != { "enp2s0", "ppp0" } ct mark != 0x0 ct mark and 0x10000 == 0x0 ct direction reply counter meta mark set ct mark
 8. exec  argv  "nft" "add" "rule" "inet" "linkguard" "conn_mark" "iifname" "!=" "{ \"enp2s0\", \"ppp0\" }" "ct" "mark" "and" "0x10000" "==" "0x10000" "ct" "direction" "original" "meta" "mark" "==" "0x0" "counter" "meta" "mark" "set" "ct" "mark" "and" "0xffff"
          cmd   nft add rule inet linkguard conn_mark iifname != { "enp2s0", "ppp0" } ct mark and 0x10000 == 0x10000 ct direction original meta mark == 0x0 counter meta mark set ct mark and 0xffff
 9. exec  argv  "nft" "flush" "chain" "inet" "linkguard" "output_mark"
          cmd   nft flush chain inet linkguard output_mark
10. exec  argv  "nft" "add" "rule" "inet" "linkguard" "output_mark" "ct" "mark" "!=" "0x0" "ct" "mark" "and" "0x10000" "==" "0x0" "ct" "direction" "reply" "counter" "meta" "mark" "set" "ct" "mark"
          cmd   nft add rule inet linkguard output_mark ct mark != 0x0 ct mark and 0x10000 == 0x0 ct direction reply counter meta mark set ct mark
11. exec  argv  "nft" "flush" "chain" "inet" "linkguard" "conn_mark_out"
          cmd   nft flush chain inet linkguard conn_mark_out
12. exec  argv  "nft" "add" "rule" "inet" "linkguard" "conn_mark_out" "oifname" "\"enp2s0\"" "ct" "direction" "original" "ct" "mark" "==" "0x0" "counter" "ct" "mark" "set" "0x100c8"
          cmd   nft add rule inet linkguard conn_mark_out oifname "enp2s0" ct direction original ct mark == 0x0 counter ct mark set 0x100c8
13. exec  argv  "nft" "add" "rule" "inet" "linkguard" "conn_mark_out" "oifname" "\"ppp0\"" "ct" "direction" "original" "ct" "mark" "==" "0x0" "counter" "ct" "mark" "set" "0x10064"
          cmd   nft add rule inet linkguard conn_mark_out oifname "ppp0" ct direction original ct mark == 0x0 counter ct mark set 0x10064
14. read  argv  "nft" "list" "table" "inet" "linkguard"
          cmd   nft list table inet linkguard
